name: Guanglian Aviation Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Guanglian Aviation Industry Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and manufacturing of aerospace equipment in China. The company offers aviation tooling, including composite material molding tooling and automated assembly tooling; and metal parts for the aviation, aerospace, shipbuilding, and engine sectors. It also manufactures composite material products comprising composite materials for complete unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), composite material parts for a certain aircraft model, composite materials for missile wings, vertical tail panels, beams, ribs, U-shaped stringer panels for control surfaces of the COMAC C929, cargo doors, thermoplastic composite materials, …
